$comment: Patches whose subject is the sound itself rather than the notes: what it
is made of, what space it sits in, how dense it is. The failure mode here
is a patch that is merely quiet or merely wet and calls itself ambient.

idioms.is: A delay whose output returns to its own input, so repeats accumulate rather than simply decaying.
idioms.sounds_right_when: repeats build and smear instead of fading identically.

topology.describe: something has to feed the mixer
the delay's output has to return to the mixer, or the repeats never build
the sum of the source and the returning signal has to go back in — an input takes one cable, so the two are mixed rather than both patched to the same jack

common_mistakes.message: the loop is never closed, so nothing accumulates

idioms.is: A sustained source into a long reverb, with the dry signal well back, so the space is the subject rather than the source.
idioms.sounds_right_when: you hear the room more than the thing in it.

topology.describe: something has to feed the reverb
the reverb has to reach the output

common_mistakes.message: the reverb never reaches the output

idioms.is: Noise shaped by a moving filter, so the texture reads as weather rather than as hiss.
idioms.sounds_right_when: the noise has a moving centre of gravity, not a fixed one.
idioms.source: Strange's treatment of noise as a sound source

listen_for.sounds_like: weather rather than an instrument: broadband, continuous, with the sense of a moving band inside it and no pitch to hold onto
listen_for.confusable_with: a very bright oscillator, which has a pitch even when it is harsh

expect.why: noise should defeat a pitch tracker; a confidently tracked pitch means an oscillator is in the path

topology.describe: noise has to reach the filter
the filter has to move, or this is static hiss

common_mistakes.message: the filter never moves, so this is fixed hiss

idioms.is: Several oscillators tuned close together and summed, so their slight differences beat against each other.
idioms.sounds_right_when: you hear slow beating that nobody is modulating.
idioms.source: Standard practice; the basis of most thick analogue sounds

topology.describe: the oscillators have to be summed for their differences to beat
the mix has to reach the output

common_mistakes.message: the oscillators are never summed, so nothing beats
the mix never reaches the output

idioms.is: A burst of noise into a short filtered delay whose feedback sustains it — the delay's length becomes the pitch and the filter becomes the decay.
idioms.sounds_right_when: you hear a pluck with a pitch, not a filtered noise burst.
idioms.source: Karplus and Strong's plucked-string algorithm, patched

topology.describe: a noise burst has to enter the loop through the mixer — the delay's input takes one cable, and that one carries the sum of the burst and what is already ringing
the delay's output has to return, or the string does not ring
the sum of the source and the returning signal has to go back in — an input takes one cable, so the two are mixed rather than both patched to the same jack

common_mistakes.message: the loop is never closed, so nothing accumulates

idioms.is: Two audio signals multiplied, producing sums and differences that rarely belong to either — inharmonic by construction.
idioms.sounds_right_when: the result is bell-like or clangorous rather than a chord.

listen_for.sounds_like: clangorous and unresolved, the two source pitches replaced by tones that belong to neither — move either source and the result moves in a direction that feels wrong
listen_for.confusable_with: amplitude modulation, where the original note survives underneath; if you can still hear the carrier, the multiplier is not balanced

axis.position: at audio rate, heard as sum and difference tones
axis.set_by: the modulator's rate — a knob; both positions on this axis patch a source into an amplifier's control input
axis.$comment: Two things this axis deliberately does NOT split. Below hearing the same patch is tremolo, which is the neighbour above. And amplitude modulation proper — where the carrier survives — differs from ring modulation, where it is cancelled, only in whether the multiplier is BALANCED. That is a property of the module's internals, not of any cable, so no checker reading a patch can tell them apart and there is no second record pretending otherwise. A listener can: if you can still hear the original note underneath, it is AM.

topology.describe: one signal has to be the carrier
the other has to modulate it at audio rate

common_mistakes.message: nothing modulates at audio rate, so there are no sidebands

idioms.is: A simple waveform driven into a folder, where increasing level adds harmonics rather than volume.
idioms.sounds_right_when: pushing the drive makes it brighter and busier rather than louder.
idioms.source: West-coast practice; the folder as a harmonic generator

topology.describe: a waveform has to reach the folder
the fold amount has to move, or the texture is fixed

common_mistakes.message: the fold amount never moves, so the texture is fixed

idioms.is: A source repeatedly re-triggered into short windows, so the ear hears a cloud of fragments rather than a continuous signal.
idioms.sounds_right_when: the texture is made of audible particles whose density can change.
idioms.source: Roads' granular synthesis, as approximated in modular

topology.describe: a fast envelope has to window the source into grains
something has to fire the grains repeatedly
there has to be a source to granulate

common_mistakes.message: nothing windows the source, so this is a continuous signal

idioms.is: A reverb whose feedback path is pitch-shifted upward, so the tail rises as it decays.
idioms.sounds_right_when: the tail climbs in pitch instead of merely fading.
idioms.source: Standard practice, after the Eno/Lanois studio technique

topology.describe: something has to feed the mixer
the reverb tail has to return, or the shift never accumulates
the sum of the source and the returning signal has to go back in — an input takes one cable, so the two are mixed rather than both patched to the same jack

common_mistakes.message: the loop is never closed, so nothing accumulates

idioms.is: A signal driven past a stage's limit so its peaks are reshaped, adding harmonics that were never in the source.
idioms.sounds_right_when: the character changes with level rather than only the loudness.

topology.describe: a signal has to reach the distortion stage
the distorted signal has to reach the output
